# 06 Distortion

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** The image deforms, degrades or breaks apart, and B emerges from the damage.

**Test.** Do the pixels bend, smear, glitch, pixelate or scatter?

**Not here.** Rigid slices are 05 Motion › Split. Blur from a whole-frame move is 05 Motion › Whip.

**Build.** Usually a shader or canvas pass, with the amount peaking at the swap point.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Glitch](glitch/) | Digital corruption. | RGB split, datamosh, block displacement |
| [Warp](warp/) | Smooth non-rigid deformation. | ripple, swirl, displacement, liquify |
| [Blur](blur/) | Focus or directional blur peaks at the cut. | defocus, zoom blur |
| [Pixel](pixel/) | The image breaks into pixels or sorted pixels. | pixelate, mosaic, pixel sort, dither |
| [Break](break/) | The image fractures into pieces or particles. | shatter, paper tear, disintegrate |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [RGB Glitch](glitch/rgb-glitch/) | Glitch | The picture tears into shifted colour channels and displaced blocks, and the new scene glitches in. |
| [Liquid Warp](warp/liquid-warp/) | Warp | The picture ripples and melts like a reflection in water, and the new scene ripples back into focus. |
| [Pixel Stretch](warp/pixel-stretch/) | Warp | The new scene sweeps in with its leading edge smeared into long streaks, like pixels stretched by speed. |
| [Defocus](blur/defocus/) | Blur | The old scene drifts out of focus, and the new one comes into focus. |
| [Pixelate](pixel/pixelate/) | Pixel | The picture breaks into growing blocks of pixels, swaps at the coarsest point, then sharpens into the new scene. |
| [Paper Tear](break/paper-tear/) | Break | The old scene rips down the middle along a ragged edge, and the two pieces pull apart to show the new scene. |
